Most free trials aren't free. They ask for a card up front, start a countdown, and quietly bill you the moment you forget to cancel. Kodely doesn't work that way. You can sign up, describe a site in plain English, generate real code, and publish it live without ever entering a card number.

Why no credit card required actually matters

Asking for payment details before someone has tried your product does two things: it filters out casual users, and it sets up a billing relationship you didn't explicitly agree to. That second part is the problem. A trial that requires a card isn't really free — it's a subscription with a delay, and the delay only benefits the company collecting the number.

Kodely's free tier skips that entirely. There is no card on file when you sign up, no countdown clock, and no auto-billing event waiting to trigger. You are not one missed cancellation away from a charge, because there is nothing set up to charge in the first place.

How Kodely's free tier actually works

Every new account gets 750 credits the moment you sign up. That's it — no card, no trial period, no plan selection. You go straight into the chat interface, describe the site you want, and Kodely generates a real Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 application: actual component files, not a template mockup. You watch the live preview render the compiled app as it's built, and you can keep describing changes in chat to refine it.

Credits are metered from the real AI cost of each generation. If a build fails to compile, Kodely automatically attempts one repair — and if that generation ultimately fails, you're not charged for it. Every successful generation also creates a checkpoint, so you can roll back to an earlier version for free if a change doesn't work out.

What happens when your credits run out

Nothing happens automatically. When your 750 credits are spent, Kodely simply prompts you to buy a top-up before you can generate more. There's no background charge, because there's still no card stored anywhere in your account unless you've deliberately added one to make a purchase. You decide if and when to spend money, not a billing system running on a timer.

What you can build with 750 free credits

750 credits is enough to design and publish a genuine working site: a landing page, a portfolio, a small marketing site, or a product page with several sections and iterations of chat-driven edits. You can go back and forth refining copy, layout, and components, and each successful generation is a free restore point, so experimenting doesn't cost you progress. When you're ready, one click on Publish puts the site live at a free yourname.kodely.site address — hosting is included, not a separate step or a separate charge.

Honest scope note

Kodely is a frontend tool today. It generates real React components and layouts, but it does not generate a backend, database, authentication, or payment processing. Sites publish to a *.kodely.site subdomain — custom domains aren't supported yet. You can view and copy the generated source code directly in the app, but there's no zip export or download yet. Editing happens through chat; there's no click-to-edit visual mode. These are current limits, not fine print, and they're worth knowing before you start.

Pricing in plain terms

The free tier is 750 credits, no card required. After that, credits are simple top-ups with no subscription and no expiration date.

$9500 creditsNever expire
$402,500 creditsMost popular, never expire
$906,000 creditsNever expire

See the full breakdown on the pricing page.

FAQ

Do I need a credit card to sign up?

No. Signing up gives you 750 credits immediately with no card on file. You only add payment details if and when you choose to buy a top-up.

Will I be charged automatically when my credits run out?

No. Kodely prompts you to purchase more credits; nothing bills automatically, and nothing bills at all unless you actively complete a purchase.

Is hosting really free, forever?

Yes. Publishing to your *.kodely.site address is included at no cost — there's no trial period on hosting and no separate hosting fee.

Can I export or download the code?

Not yet. You can view and copy the generated source files inside the app, but there's no zip export or download option today.

Does Kodely support custom domains or a backend?

Not yet. Kodely currently generates frontend-only React applications published to *.kodely.site subdomains. Custom domains, backends, databases, and authentication generation are not available.

Ready to see it for yourself? Start building free — no credit card, just 750 credits and a chat box.
